links.outcome: Incorrect information, omission, and harm in LLM vs physician influenza advice rated by physician panel
links.effect: No significant difference in incorrect information, omission, harm extent or empathy; LLM advice was more likely to cause harm and to be in line with medical consensus.
links.quote: Nevertheless, compared to physician advice, LLM advice was more likely to cause harm and to be in line with medical consensus.

unlisted_practices: Using an LLM to rewrite physician replies to improve emotional support (respect, friendliness, empathy) while preserving medical content

screen.reason: Empirical comparison of LLM-generated vs. physician-generated and LLM-polished responses to patient questions from an online health community, evaluated retrospectively by physicians and an LLM module without testing a specific deployment safeguard/practice.
